security.policy_notes: Future implementation must enforce current Policy and owner Ability checks. Destructive scopes require server-side preview, typed confirmation bound to the previewed scope hash, a verified restore point by default, operation locks, and preservation of the current operator, site URLs, salts and Reset/Backup control data. multisite.notes: Network and per-site reset scopes must remain explicit; a site reset must never silently mutate network/global tables, users or settings.

must_not: No reset, deletion, truncation, drop, restore, or destructive runtime side effect is authorized by this contract.
